exclusions: Do not convert attributed statements, casualty figures or interception figures into verified facts
Do not treat publications sharing the overnight Kyiv attack lineage as independent corroboration
Do not retain precise sensitive-site or targeting-enabling detail
definition_of_done: Atomic attributable observations are linked to the accepted source item
Criticism, requested support, sanctions language, qualifiers and common upstream lineage are preserved
No claim assessment, reliability judgment or report narrative is added
Two separate self-review rounds passed and a receipt was persisted

result.summary: Extracted three draft atomic reaction observations from the frozen Guardian source item: attributed criticism of delayed air-defence deliveries, a request for additional air-defence support, and a request for additional sanctions. Guardian attribution, later-edit uncertainty, and shared Kyiv-attack lineage were preserved; no underlying statement or strike effect was independently verified.
coverage_gaps: The accepted Guardian page was retrieved after a later edit, and the exact first-published article text was not captured.
The underlying Zelenskyy social-media post was not separately registered with a stable primary canonical URL.
The observations rely on the source-item title and short verification note preserved in the discovery manifest rather than a copied article body.
The observations do not independently verify delayed deliveries, casualty figures, interception figures, damage, weapon type, targeting intent, or strike attribution.
